decisions.reason: Documentation/contract request about polling Sleep after completion; no present failing timer program or missing coroutine origin is reported.
decisions.reason_zh: Sleep 完成后能否继续 poll 的文档契约请求，没有报告正在失败的计时器程序或协程来源缺失。

decisions.reason: Windows named-pipe read_buf returns an8192-byte message as two4096-byte reads; the report does not claim bytes lost. Short-read semantics/buffering are distinct from missing Task provenance; no Linux substitute is run.
decisions.reason_zh: Windows named pipe 的8192字节输入分成两次4096字节读取，未报告字节丢失。关注点是短读取语义与系统缓冲，尚未建立 Task 来源缺口；未用 Linux 管道替代。

decisions.reason: The source is a hypothesis about VecDeque contention during60k-100k spawn_blocking RocksDB multi-get operations on100-core hardware, not a pinned reproducer. Actual workload, dataset and lock evidence are missing; no sleep-based or smaller-task substitute is run.
decisions.reason_zh: 报告提出60k–100k个 spawn_blocking/RocksDB multi-get 与队列锁竞争的性能假设，没有固定复现程序。实际工作负载、数据集和锁证据未提供，未用 sleep 或更小任务量替代。

database_preparation.findings: Maintainer confirms a pool-of-one can return the same disposed transaction object, and another Dispose through an old reference can roll back the next transaction. Maintainers describe object recycling as intentional; no security conclusion follows from managed disposal exceptions.
database_preparation.blocker: Source/capture design and broad cache discovery exceeded the first-check wall budget before any project build or database workload. Stop now; package availability is a prerequisite observation, not a reproduction.
database_preparation.required_observations: Exact transaction ReferenceEquals/object identity, logical lease/owner generation, and old-reference Dispose origin. Task ancestry alone cannot distinguish recycled-object ownership.
database_preparation.next_action: No more setup in this pass. A later batch may use the located SDK/cache for one faithful pool-of-one component; no pool-exhaustion or wrong-connection claim without native evidence.

classification_clarification: No new automatic-review rejection or security finding in this batch. Managed disposal exceptions, stream errors and performance hypotheses are debugging evidence, not vulnerability conclusions.
